description: Turn an animation video or GIF (from Kling, Veo, Sora or a capture) into a sprite sheet: frames at your fps, background removed, every frame aligned to one box and pivot so it does not jitter, the best loop point, TexturePacker JSON, Godot SpriteFrames and a GIF preview. Price: $0.15 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

background.description: auto: keep the video's own transparency, key a one-color background, or use AI (max 24 frames).
